findings.title: verify_execution_identity does not force validate_launch_request/validate_receipt; expected_agent_sid is a caller-fillable field, not manifest-bound
findings.evidence: p1/runner.py:320-352: verify calls no validate_* anywhere. build_launch_request(:78-111) never emits expected_agent_sid; verify reads it via request.get(:330). RunnerClient.manifest() validates its own copy but verify takes no manifest parameter and never compares request['expected_agent_sid'] against it. Probes a04/a09c: with validate skipped, an unsigned request, fully misbound receipt (task/run/idempotency all wrong) and fabricated capture digests still attests.
findings.impact: The audit question 'Agent SID bound to trusted manifest, not caller-filled' answers NO at the verify layer: the pin is whatever the caller stuffed into the request dict. Today no dispatch path exists (executor gate intact), so not P0; becomes exploitable the moment Stage-2B-2 wires the client.
findings.minimal_fix: verify_execution_identity must call validate_launch_request(request) + validate_receipt(receipt, request) first, and take expected_agent_sid from a manifest argument, not the request dict.

findings.title: process_alive parameter conflates liveness check with identity measurement (probe = process_alive or live_process_token)
findings.evidence: p1/runner.py:329,335-347. Probe a06 (21bao): passing a real liveness predicate (returns bool) crashes with TypeError('bool' object is not subscriptable); passing a dict-returning fake REPLACES the live token measurement entirely, and the same branch (:342-347) also skips live_process_image - the image is then taken from the receipt self-report.
findings.impact: Survival vs identity are the two things the audit brief demands be separate; one injected parameter silently changes meaning of both checks. Injection seam = bypass seam.
findings.minimal_fix: Split into two parameters: liveness: Callable[[int],bool] always consulted; identity probe not injectable (or injected results marked unattested). Never fall back to receipt fields for image when a probe is injected.

findings.title: render_agent_markdown accepts permissions={'auto':'allow'} and renders it, violating the declared 'auto is always denied' rule
findings.evidence: p1/harness/opencode.py:97-98: value = 'deny' if key in DEFAULT_DENY_PERMISSIONS and key not in perms else perms.get(key,'ask') - explicit auto bypasses the deny. Probe b01 reproduces: rendered markdown contains 'auto: allow'.
findings.impact: A matrix typo or tampered config lets the OpenCode agent self-approve permissions, directly contradicting module docstring (:85) and the Stage-2A design constraint. This was the specific reproduction the audit brief requested.
findings.minimal_fix: Emit deny unconditionally for DEFAULT_DENY_PERMISSIONS keys; raise OpenCodeProbeError if caller supplies any other value for them.

findings.title: agent_pid has no liveness/instance binding: token of an exited-but-handle-held process still reads; PID reuse unguarded
findings.evidence: Probe a08 (21bao, timed evidence t+0.0..2.0s): after proc.wait(), winjobs.process_alive(pid)=False yet runner.live_process_token(pid) still returns the dead process SID (S-1-5-21-...-1001). verify never compares started_at/finished_at against process creation time (GetProcessTimes not used).
findings.impact: A receipt naming a dead or recycled pid can pass the 'live token' check while proving the identity of a different process instance.
findings.minimal_fix: Require liveness + process-start-time match inside verify; reject non-live pids.

findings.title: Receipt lacks model/role/reviewed_commit binding; harness_version and argv_sha256 compared against nothing
findings.evidence: RECEIPT_REQUIRED_FIELDS (p1/runner.py:52-59) contains no model/role/reviewed_commit/argv; validate_receipt(:131-151) never compares harness_version or argv_sha256 to the request or frozen snapshot. Probes a21/a22: a receipt generated for a different-model run validates cleanly; argv_sha256='9'*64 passes.
findings.impact: Cannot prove the launched process used the approved model/role/commit/argv - the core binding the audit brief lists for receipts.
findings.minimal_fix: Add model/role/reviewed_commit to the receipt and cross-check against request; bind argv_sha256 to build_command's command_sha256; bind harness_version to the frozen snapshot.

findings.title: poll() returns outbox receipt JSON without validate_receipt and without provenance
findings.evidence: p1/runner.py:466-467 returns read_json(receipt_path) raw. Probe a20 (21bao): junk file {'status':'COMPLETED','agent_pid':1,'anything':1} in outbox -> poll returns state=RECEIPT; validate_receipt would reject it but is never called.
findings.impact: Reconciliation consumes unvalidated data; whoever can write the spool outbox fabricates dispatch outcomes.
findings.minimal_fix: poll must validate_receipt(receipt, request) before returning and bind to manifest identity.

findings.title: runner_health proves manifest presence, not service liveness; docstring overstates
findings.evidence: p1/runner.py:427-440. Probe a15 (21bao): complete manifest + matching runner exe digest + no runner service process -> {'available': True, 'reason': 'manifest provisioned'}.
findings.impact: 'available' invites future callers to treat provisioning as a live runner; actual blocking comes only from the unimplemented transport in launch().
findings.minimal_fix: Add a heartbeat probe (spool heartbeat timestamp / named event), or rename the field manifest_provisioned.

findings.title: verify_ledger_inaccessible inspects only the ledger ROOT DACL; independent child ACEs invisible
findings.evidence: Probe a19 (21bao, live icacls): root clean, child dir artifacts granted Everyone (OI)(CI)(RX) -> check passes. Code :355-372 queries once.
findings.impact: Same residual class as R6-002: 'DACL demonstrably excluding the agent principal' holds at root level only. Provisioning discipline (no unprotected child ACEs) bounds real risk, but the mechanism does not prove it.
findings.minimal_fix: Query the known ledger child paths (reuse trust.py batch ACL probe) instead of root only.

findings.title: extra_argv can duplicate or override reserved flags (-m, -s, sandbox-bypass switches) without guard
findings.evidence: codex.py:104 / opencode.py:129 append extra_argv verbatim. Probe b05: extra_argv=['-m','unapproved-model-z','--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox'] -> argv contains '-m' twice and the bypass flag; most CLI parsers let the later value win.
findings.impact: A poisoned/typoed matrix entry silently defeats the frozen model/sandbox constraints.
findings.minimal_fix: Reject extra_argv entries colliding with reserved flags (-m/--model/-s/--sandbox/-C/--cd/--json) or known bypass switches.

findings.title: merge_runner_records has no provenance gate: any caller-supplied list upgrades trusted; one record can validate multiple claimed invocations of the same command
findings.evidence: codex.py:178-195 / opencode.py:201-216: runner_records is a bare parameter with no runner signature/manifest binding. Probe b10: forged list -> trusted=True. Probe b11: dict keyed by command; a single exit-0 record marks BOTH claimed entries (from different invocations) - entry 0 trusted by a record from a different run.
findings.impact: The stated rule 'exit codes become trusted only when the Runner records agree' lacks an authenticated source for those records and lacks per-invocation binding.
findings.minimal_fix: Require runner_records to come from an attested receipt/ledger path; key by (command, invocation ordinal/pid) not command alone.

findings.title: Job assignment race: descendants born before assign_pid escape the job and survive terminate/close
findings.evidence: Probe d02 (21bao, live): parent spawns grandchild BEFORE job.assign_pid(parent) -> TerminateJobObject kills parent, grandchild still alive (verified, then cleaned via taskkill). winjobs.py offers no CREATE_SUSPENDED/assign-before-resume helper.
findings.impact: When the Runner Popen-spawns the harness, early-forked children escape the kill boundary - the residual window of the R2-008 descendant-tree issue. Mechanism itself works (d01/d04 pass: two-generation kill and holder-crash kill both verified).
findings.minimal_fix: Provide a suspended-spawn + assign-then-resume wrapper; or nested job / process-notification registration.

findings.title: p1_init handler forwards only --home, dropping the other 7 required init flags; init can never succeed
findings.evidence: integrations/hermes/p1_orchestrator/__init__.py:133-139 _simple_handler uses _require_home only, while the schema (:100-110) declares 8 required fields. Probe c01 (21bao): forwarded argv tail == ['--home', home]; CLI rc=2 surfaced honestly.
findings.impact: Functional defect in the uninstalled draft; fails closed (CLI refuses), so non-blocking.

findings.title: _invoke caps stderr at 500 chars but leaves stdout unbounded
findings.evidence: Probe c04: 5 MB stdout passes into result dict verbatim (__init__.py:58-67).
findings.impact: Abnormal CLI output can balloon memory/session context; inconsistent with P1 bounded-capture principle.

findings.title: bash events without a command field yield a literal 'None' command record
findings.impact: Ghost 'None' commands pollute the evidence stream and reconciliation.
findings.minimal_fix: Skip non-str commands or tag them no-command.

findings.title: build_command raises bare KeyError on missing request['role'] before model validation
findings.impact: Uncontrolled exception type loses the error semantics; still no dispatch.

findings.title: validate_receipt does not cross-check status against exit_code
findings.evidence: Probe a13b: FAILED+exit0, COMPLETED+exit1, KILLED+exit0 all validate.
findings.impact: Semantically contradictory receipts can be stored; downstream readers trusting status alone are misled.
findings.minimal_fix: COMPLETED requires exit 0; FAILED/TIMEOUT/KILLED require nonzero/timeout markers.
